hypothesis: A broad positive China cash-session close, observed before the U.S. cash open on the same calendar date, reflects globally persistent risk-on information and capital-flow sentiment that carries into the subsequent U.S. cash session. Buying Nasdaq and S&P 500 at the U.S. open only after both CSI300 and Shanghai Composite close higher should produce a repeatable positive open-to-close return without overnight exposure.
